title: Game Pack Rules (game.json) — v1
description: The rules of a game, expressed as data (Phase 3 A1; design: docs/plans/2026-06-13-phase3-1-pack-schemas.md in ALN-Ecosystem). game.json answers 'how does this game score and flow'; the pack-manifest answers 'what is in this pack'. v1 constrains to the engine-implemented subset; enum values marked HEADROOM in the design doc are included only where the engine can validate-and-reject them cleanly at load time. The AUTH FLOOR (owner decision 2026-07-09) is encoded structurally: session-lifecycle, show-control, and score-intervention accept only ["staffed"]. Invariants not expressible here (enforced by the contract test): mode ids unique; defaultEntity only meaningful on attribution-role modes; typeMultipliers keys must cover the token database's SF_MemoryType values.

requires.description: Engine capability ids this pack needs. The engine's capability gate refuses activation LOUDLY when any id is outside its implemented set — headroom is never silently absorbed. Optional: a pack that declares nothing is gated on nothing beyond schema/engine versions.

modes.description: B1: a game defines its own transaction modes (1..n). Wire 'mode' values are validated against this list at runtime.

verb.description: PRESENTATION stratum (never branched on). Declared-NOT-YET-CONSUMED: the present-tense action affordance (mode selector / scan button) is Track-D UX territory; no engine site reads verb today. It cannot derive claimedLabel ('Sell' -> 'SOLD to {entity}' is not computable morphology).

verbNoun.description: A3 slice 7 (PRESENTATION stratum — never branched on; additive-optional, NO schemaVersion bump per the R-Q2 precedent). The NOUN form of this mode's action ('Sale', 'Fence') — rendered as the session report's Scoring Timeline Type cell for claims in this mode. Distinct from the sibling 'verb' (present-tense affordance, 'Sell'): noun morphology is not computable from it. Absent ⇒ engine-generic 'Claim' (benign-wording class); declared-but-undrivable ⇒ activation refusal (R-3b-1 twin class). Pattern forbids pipes/braces and the C0 controls (newlines included) — the cell must never split a markdown table row; DEL and bidi controls pass the pattern but are stripped-then-checked by the VALUE twins (activation gate + scanner DECLINE), which are the runtime authority (the generator sanitizes too; this pattern is the authoring-time twin, deliberately no stricter than the values the twins can accept). Same boundary rule as claimedLabel: mode-varying wording lives here, all other report wording lives in strings.report.*.

claimedLabel.description: A3 closers R-Q2 (PRESENTATION stratum — never branched on; additive-optional, NO schemaVersion bump per the D3s2 precedent). The past-tense claim ANNOUNCEMENT as a TEMPLATE containing exactly one {entity} token (e.g. 'SOLD to {entity}', 'EXPOSED by {entity}') — a template because the preposition varies per mode and word order must survive future packs. Rendered as TEXT (escaped) with the entity substituted via function replacement. Absent ⇒ engine-generic 'CLAIMED by {entity}' (benign-wording class); declared-but-undrivable ⇒ activation refusal (R-3b-1 twin class). NOT cross-checked against scoringPolicy — a non-scoring mode still renders potential value, not an amount paid (authoring hazard). Boundary rule: wording that varies WITH THE MODE and is needed at call sites holding only a mode id lives here; all other pack wording lives in strings.*.

icon.description: A3 closers R-Q2 (PRESENTATION stratum). A short TEXT GLYPH (emoji) shown beside the claim announcement. Renders as TEXT CONTENT ONLY — never into a class, attribute, CSS custom property or style (unlike cues.json's 'icon', which is a CSS class key). Escaped at every interpolation regardless.

scoringPolicy.description: OPEN vocabulary (slice 1): any string is schema-valid; the ENGINE's capability gate refuses activation of values it cannot drive (engine 3.x drives: 'standard', 'none'). New values ship WITH their engine module + capability id — never by schema edit alone.

entityRole.description: O1/P2 (corrected 2026-07-09): what the entity field MEANS in this mode — 'ledger' = wallet/account that accumulates value; 'attribution' = byline identity receiving narrative credit (feeds the report, never score math). OPEN vocabulary (slice 1): schema-valid as any string; the engine's gate refuses values it cannot drive (engine 3.x drives: 'ledger', 'attribution').

defaultEntity.description: Optional picker prefill for this mode (e.g. the anonymous NPC identity in an attribution-role mode)

claims.description: A2/D3s2: whether a transaction in this mode CONSUMES the token. 'consuming' (the default when absent — every pre-claims mode consumed) registers a FCFS claim under duplicatePolicy; 'non-consuming' is a repeatable action — never blocked by the duplicate rules, never registering a claim. OPEN vocabulary (slice 1 convention): schema-valid as any string; the engine's gate refuses values it cannot drive (engine 3.x drives: 'consuming', 'non-consuming'). v1 limitation: 'non-consuming' with countsTowardGroups is refused at activation (non-consumed group presence needs its own contribution-semantics design).

surface.description: OPEN vocabulary (slice 1): schema-valid as any string; the engine's gate refuses surfaces it cannot render (engine 3.x drives: 'scoreboard-rankings', 'scoreboard-evidence', 'none'). B12/slice 6 makes the surface set pack-extensible through this same seam.

scoring.description: B2/B6: pack-supplied tables over the engine's fixed formula base[rating] × mult[type]. Absorbs scoring-config.json (legacy file read as fallback during migration only).

typeMultipliers.description: Keys are the token database's SF_MemoryType values; UNKNOWN is the required fallback for null/unrecognized types

format.description: Money display spec (A3 slice 3b, ruling R-3b-1): exactly one '#,###' number token (signed integer, comma-grouped) wrapped by literal prefix/suffix affixes — e.g. "$#,###" or "#,### cr". Schema-open elsewhere, gate-enforced: the engine refuses formats it cannot drive.

groupRules.description: B3/A1. v1 engine implements type 'all'; 'threshold' and 'ordered' are schema headroom — a pack declaring them is REJECTED at load until the engine grows the variant.

groups.description: D1b (A3 slice 2b): group multipliers are GAME RULES and live here — tokens carry only the group NAME (tokens.schema v2 kills the '(xN)' microformat). Keys are group display names; the activation gate refuses a v2 pack whose tokens name an undeclared group (loud, boot-time). The per-token multiplier redundancy and its inconsistent-variant failure class die with this block.

duplicatePolicy.description: A2: token claim consumption. v1 engine implements claim 'once' (FCFS, session-scoped, all transacting modes).

entities.description: O1/P1: the score-holder is an abstract ledger; the pack names it and sets creation policy. Wire field remains teamId (alias) through Phase 3.

functions.description: O2/P4: pack assigns engine functions to device classes, validated against class affordances (P5) at design time. AUTH FLOOR (owner 2026-07-09): the three floor functions are structurally locked to ["staffed"] — a pack cannot assign them lower, by schema.

gameClock.description: B11. ALN is the degenerate case: one phase + overtime threshold. Durations in SECONDS.

lightingRoles.description: B8: the pack's lighting vocabulary; cues reference these names, the installation profile binds them to instruments. Optional until the role-extraction slice.

strings.description: Declares the display-strings sidecar (A3 slice 3a). The value is the CANONICAL filename — every consumer (manifest role assignment, the scanner's staged-refresh rules set, the engine gate) is keyed to it, so declaring means presence, not naming. Relaxing to a free filename requires role-follows-pointer support in BOTH manifest builders and the scanner loader first.

theme.description: Names the pack's visual-identity sidecar (theme unit; canonical filename const — the strings/cues pointer pattern; manifest role + scanner loader are keyed to it). A pack declaring this must list theme.identity in `requires` (the surfaces.select gate-lint precedent). Tightened from a loose .json pattern nothing ever read (r1 census).

cues.description: Declares the show-cues sidecar (A3 slice 4). The value is the CANONICAL filename — every consumer (manifest role assignment, the engine's pack-file resolution, the gate) is keyed to it, so declaring means presence, not naming (3a strings precedent). A pack declaring cues must also declare the matching `requires` capability ids (cues.standing / cues.timeline / lighting.roles); the gate rule that refuses the incoherent combination lands with slice-4 S2.

lightingRoleFallbacks.description: TEMPORARY (ledger L7, retires at C4): one concrete venue scene id per lighting role, used ONLY when the installation profile has no binding for that role — and every such use warns loudly. Keys must be declared in lightingRoles (gate-checked). This block is the sanctioned home for concrete scene ids in a pack; cue payloads themselves are role-only by schema.

surfaces.description: A3 slice 6 (B12): the pack SELECTS and PARAMETERIZES the three built-in display surfaces (idle loop, scoreboard, video). The surface SET is engine-fixed — a pack cannot define NEW surfaces (the constellation renderer is BILL-era headroom). A pack declaring `surfaces` must list 'surfaces.select' in `requires` (the cues/lightingRoles gate precedent).

idleLoop.description: The idle-loop surface's venue-channel NAME (Q6-2) — NOT a filename. The installation profile binds the channel to a concrete media file; `config.display.idleLoopFile` is the loud fallback. `null` = this game has no idle loop (Q6-1 opt-out). Absent = the engine default idle loop. The lowercase-dash pattern forbids paths/filenames by construction.

enabled.description: false = this game has no scoreboard surface (Q6-1 opt-out); the engine refuses display:scoreboard. Absent = true.

evidenceCycleMs.description: Q6-3 parameter: the BASE evidence-page cycling interval in ms. The engine speeds up to round(this*2/3) when 4+ pages (engine adaptation, not a pack value). Absent = engine default 18000.

floorFunction.description: AUTH FLOOR: exactly ["staffed"], non-negotiable by packs
